anglo.title: China criticises idea it is in 'malicious competition' over AI

china.title: China In Photos: Fear-mongering will only hamper efforts toward sound global AI governance: spokesperson

points.anglo_quote: China has hit out against what it has called "threat narratives" over AI governance and warned against "engaging in confrontation and malicious competition".
points.china_quote: Fear-mongering, confrontation and vicious competition will only hamper efforts toward sound global AI governance, which serves no one's interest, a Chinese foreign ministry spokesperson said on Monday.
points.explain_ko: 영미권 매체는 'China has hit out'로 중국을 주체로 직접 표현한 반면, 중국 매체는 'a Chinese foreign ministry spokesperson said'로 중국 외교부 대변인을 주체로 삼아 간접적으로 전함.

points.anglo_quote: On Monday, China's foreign ministry spokesperson Guo Jiakun told reporters that "narratives of threat, confrontation, and malicious competition serve only to disrupt the process of global AI governance and are not in anyone's interest".
points.china_quote: "AI is a consequential technology for the well-being of all humanity. All parties should jointly promote the open and inclusive development of AI for good and for all," Guo told a regular press briefing.
points.explain_ko: 영미권 매체는 대변인의 'narratives of threat...' 발언을 인용하며 위협 서사와 악의적 경쟁을 비판하는 부분을 강조함. 중국 매체는 대변인의 AI가 인류 복지에 중요하다는 긍정적 메시지와 협력 촉구 발언을 인용함.
